title: Rule Policy Configuration
description: Schema for cppcheck/MISRA rule policy configuration defining auto-fix strategies and risk levels.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation and autocompletion.

actions.description: Rule-specific action configurations. Keys are rule identifiers (e.g., 'unusedVariable', 'misra-c2012-2.2').

patterns.description: Pattern-based action configurations. Matched against code context to determine action.

actionType.description:
The type of action to take:
- fix: Direct fix without special handling (legacy, use auto_fix instead)
- skip: Skip this rule, do not attempt any fix
- auto_fix: Safe to apply automatically
- careful_fix: Requires careful review but can be auto-applied
- needs_manual_review: Requires human review before any changes

riskLevel.description:
Risk level associated with the fix:
- low: Minimal impact, safe to auto-fix
- medium: Moderate impact, needs careful review
- high: Significant impact, requires manual review

risk_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this risk level was assigned.

$comment.description: Self-documenting comment explaining the rationale for this configuration, useful for maintenance and onboarding.

match_contains.description: Substring pattern to match in code context (case-sensitive).

risk_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this risk level was assigned.

$comment.description: Self-documenting comment explaining the rationale for this pattern configuration, useful for maintenance and onboarding.
